storage: Wrap in a paper towel or cloth and keep in the fridge crisper for 3 to 5 days; cut pieces can be frozen raw for a few weeks.
looksLike: A long, thin, ridged green pod, 30 to 60 cm long, with a tough skin and a soft, seed-dotted pulp inside. It is cut into 5 to 8 cm pieces for cooking and the pulp is scraped out with the teeth.
howToPick: Slim, firm, bright green pods that snap when bent. Avoid thick, woody, yellowing or shrivelled pods; they are mostly fibre.
shelfLife: About 3 to 5 days in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Raw mango strips or green beans

usedIn.raw: 25 g per serving (1 piece, about 6 cm)
